module.title: Security Management
module.description: Manage users, roles, sessions, policies, and security settings

max-total-users.title: Max Total Users
max-total-users.description: Maximum number of total users allowed in the system

manage-identity-providers.title: Manage Identity Providers
manage-identity-providers.description: Enable identity provider management on the Platform Console

user.title: User
user.search-result-description: User account, access state, and sign-in readiness

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Assign roles for the current tenant and application workspace.

save-user-first.title: Save The User First
save-user-first.description: Create and save the user before assigning roles for this workspace.

password.title: Password
password.description: Credential used for sign-in (set or reset by admins as allowed by policy).

pin-code.title: Security PIN
pin-code.description: PIN used to confirm sensitive actions for this user.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Roles that grant permissions to this user.

effective-state.title: Effective Access Status
effective-state.description: Overall state for lists and operations, derived from the account lifecycle and sign-in gate.

account-lifecycle.title: Account Lifecycle
account-lifecycle.description: Provisioning state controlled by an administrator.

access-state.title: Sign-In Access
access-state.description: Whether sign-in is allowed, blocked by security, or blocked until credentials are renewed. Updates follow the transitions defined for this field; the authentication layer may also change it.

home-tenant.title: Home Tenant
home-tenant.description: Directory-owning tenant for this identity. Admins in this tenant may update profile fields such as display name, email, and avatar.

password-changed-at.title: Password Changed At
password-changed-at.description: When the password was last changed.

pin-changed-at.title: PIN Changed At
pin-changed-at.description: When the security PIN was last changed.

last-sign-in-at.title: Last Sign-In At
last-sign-in-at.description: When this user last signed in successfully.

password-reset.title: Password Reset Challenge
password-reset.description: Internal one-time password reset token state.

send-password-reset.title: Send Password Reset Email
send-password-reset.confirm-message: Send a password reset email to {{user}}?

error.title: Send Failed
error.description: Failed to send password reset email.

descriptions.pending: Invitation sent or account created but not yet activated.
descriptions.active: Account is enabled for normal use subject to sign-in rules.
descriptions.suspended: Temporarily on hold; administrators can restore when appropriate.
descriptions.inactive: Disabled by an administrator; not in day-to-day use until re-enabled.
descriptions.archived: Closed or retained for history; not intended for interactive use.

descriptions.allowed: Sign-in is permitted when the account lifecycle also allows access.
descriptions.blocked: Sign-in is denied by security policy or the authentication layer (e.g. lockout).
descriptions.expired: The password or primary credential must be renewed before sign-in.

descriptions.pending: User must complete activation before normal access.
descriptions.active: Account and sign-in gate allow normal use.
descriptions.sign-in-blocked: Access is denied at sign-in even if the account is otherwise enabled.
descriptions.credential-expired: Primary credential is no longer valid until renewal.
descriptions.suspended: Account is temporarily suspended by an administrator.
descriptions.inactive: Account is disabled by an administrator.

role.title: Role
role.search-result-description: Role identity used for membership and access

save-role-first.title: Save The Role First
save-role-first.description: Create and save the role before assigning permissions for this workspace.

session.title: Session
session.search-result-description: Active device and login session information

policy.title: Policy
policy.search-result-description: Security policy and access rule configuration

identity-provider.title: Identity Provider
identity-provider.search-result-description: External sign-in broker (Google, Microsoft, OIDC, SAML)

administration-category.title: Administration
administration-category.description: User access, permissions, sessions, and account activity audit reports.

category.title: Access History
category.description: Historical roles and permissions reconstructed from Change History.

user-effective-roles-history.title: User Role History
user-effective-roles-history.description: Roles a user held that overlap the selected date range.

user-effective-permissions-history.title: User Permission History
user-effective-permissions-history.description: Permissions a user held that overlap the selected date range.

role-holders-history.title: Users by Role
role-holders-history.description: Users who held a role that overlaps the selected date range.

permission-holders-history.title: Users by Permission
permission-holders-history.description: Users who held a permission that overlaps the selected date range.

user-password-change-history.title: Password Change History
user-password-change-history.description: Last recorded password change for this user when it falls in the selected date range.

permission-search.title: Permission
permission-search.description: Search by permission title, description, or key (contains).
permission-search.placeholder: Search permission title, description, or key

permission-key.title: Permission
permission-key.description: Exact permission key to find historical holders (for example Administration:Permission:MaintainUsersAndRoles).

password-change-filters.title: Password Change Filters
password-change-filters.description: User and date range for password change history.

notes.v1-grant-assignment-only: v1 reconstructs UserRole and RolePermission grant history only; tenant membership is assumed.

no-permissions.title: No Permissions Assigned
no-permissions.description: No permissions have been assigned to this role yet. Add permissions to define access rights.

no-results.title: No Permissions Found
no-results.description: Try a different search term or clear the search to browse permissions by module.
